page_title: MET 0-1 REN | Metz v Rennes 28/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+2' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Brice Samba!
90+2' Metz have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Joel Asoro (Metz) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Brice Samba easily deals with the threat.
90+1' Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) sends a chip pass into the box, but Brice Samba is quickest to intercept the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Boubacar Traore as he is replaced by Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz).

83' Breel Embolo (Rennes) has a good opportunity as he meets a cross on the edge of the six-yard box and heads it towards the target. One of the defenders stands on the goal line and manages to keep the ball out.
82' Gauthier Hein (Metz) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

81' Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Metz will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
79' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:2.
76' Habib Beye has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mohamed Meite (Rennes) replacing Esteban Lepaul.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) is coming onto the pitch as Ibou Sane cannot continue after picking up an injury.
76' The referee signals a substitution. Malick Mbaye (Metz) is brought on as a substitute for Fode Ballo-Toure.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alpha Toure (Metz) comes onto the pitch so that Jessy Deminguet can be given a rest.
72' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
69' The free kick from long range, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
68' Jeremy Stinat interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Terry Yegbe (Metz). Rennes win a free kick.
65' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
62' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lilian Brassier walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
62' Here comes a substitution. Anthony Rouault (Rennes) is brought on as a substitute for Djaoui Cisse.
62' Habib Beye has decided to make a change. Quentin Merlin (Rennes) replaces Przemyslaw Frankowski.
61' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Rennes.

61' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The ball is out of play and Rennes manage to earn a corner.
59' Metz are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
55' Gauthier Hein (Metz) takes the corner.
54' Fode Ballo-Toure (Metz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Metz get a corner.
51' Joel Asoro (Metz) has a goal ruled out for offside!
51' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jonathan Fischer, who smothers the ball.
50' Flag goes up against Joel Asoro (Metz) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Ibou Sane (Metz) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
45+1' The linesman signals that Mousa Tamari (Rennes) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Esteban Lepaul (Rennes).
44' Gauthier Hein (Metz) will take a corner kick.
44' Joel Asoro (Metz) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Metz will take a corner kick.

40' CHANCE! Ibou Sane (Metz) fires just wide of the right post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Georgiy Tsitaishvili. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
37' Gauthier Hein (Metz) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
36' Fode Ballo-Toure (Metz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
34' Terry Yegbe (Metz) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
34' It will be a corner kick for Metz.
33' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Metz.
31' Gauthier Hein (Metz) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
29' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) meets a precise pass with a nice touch on the edge of the box and produces a shot to the middle of the goal. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
27' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) rises above the defending players to meet the corner kick. His header goes to the middle of the goal, but Jonathan Fischer is alert and manages to keep the ball out.
27' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
25' Gauthier Hein (Metz) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
25' Valentin Rongier (Rennes) commits a rough challenge and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul. Metz earn a free kick.

22' 0 - 1 It's in! Breel Embolo spots his teammate in a good position on the edge of the box and provides him with a nice pass. Valentin Rongier (Rennes) doesn't think twice and rifles a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. The score is now 0:1.
19' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Joel Asoro comes onto the pitch to replace him.
17' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
16' Rennes win a corner.
16' Valentin Rongier (Rennes) has a sight of goal and fires from the edge of the box, but his strike rattles the left post!

15' Breel Embolo (Rennes) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
13' Rennes hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
10' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
8' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
7' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle. Breel Embolo (Rennes) commits a foul after dangerous play.
3' Valentin Rongier (Rennes) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
3' One of the players from Metz times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Metz will kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat will supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
